# @productcraft/auth API reference

<!-- snippet-preamble: import { Auth } from "@productcraft/auth"; const auth = new Auth(); -->

Every method of `Auth`, grouped by resource. Types are under the `Auth` namespace (`import type { Auth } from "@productcraft/auth"`). Every method takes per-request options last (`{ idempotencyKey, timeout, maxRetries, headers, signal, workspaceId }`).

## apps

### `auth.apps.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps` → `Auth.App`

Create a new app owned by the caller.

The new app starts with emails to its users turned on: they go out from the workspace default sender chosen in Mail, and the default verification, welcome, password-reset, invite and sign-in code templates are created in the workspace's Mail templates (an existing template with the same name is reused). Change or turn this off with `PATCH /v1/apps/{appId}/notification-settings`.

**Sign-up starts off.** A new app has `signup_enabled: false`, so `POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/signup` answers 403 `FORBIDDEN` ("Signup is disabled for this app") until you turn it on with `PATCH /v1/apps/{app_id}/auth-config` and `{ "signup_enabled": true }`. Sign-in, invites and admin-created users work either way.

- Params: `Auth.AppCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (slug, display name, or workspaceId). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller email not verified, or caller lacks `auth.create` on the target workspace. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Slug already taken. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const app = await auth.apps.create({
  display_name: "Acme",
  slug: "acme-app",
  workspace_id: "835015dc-7bde-4a8a-b306-c066d4733b90",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps)

### `auth.apps.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/apps` → `PagePromise<Auth.App>`

List apps in workspaces the caller is a member of. Pass `workspace_id` to scope the result to a single workspace — required from the per-workspace console page so cross-tenant memberships do not leak.

- Params: `Auth.AppListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid pagination cursor. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const app of auth.apps.list()) {
  console.log(app);
}
const page = await auth.apps.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-v1-apps)

## stats

### `auth.stats.me(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/stats/me` → `Auth.PlatformUserStats`

Aggregate counts for the signed-in PlatformUser.

Returns total Auth apps owned by workspaces the caller is a member of, end-users across those apps, and active API keys across those apps. Pass `workspace_id` to scope the counts to a single workspace — required from the dashboard so cross-tenant data does not bleed into the totals.

- Params: `Auth.StatsMeParams`
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const platformUserStats = await auth.stats.me();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-v1-stats-me)

### `auth.stats.retrieve(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stats` → `Auth.AuthWorkspaceStats`

Auth stats for a workspace.

Active end users over 1, 7 and 30 days, total and new end users, production app count, last end-user activity and a daily active-users series, for the workspace's **production** apps only.

**Active** means the end user signed in successfully or refreshed a session. Customer backends verify access tokens locally against the JWKS, so use between two refreshes is invisible to ProductCraft; resolution is bounded by each app's access-token lifetime.

Days are UTC. Counts only: no end-user identifiers. Cached for up to 60 seconds (`generated_at`).

- Params: `Auth.StatsRetrieveParams`
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `workspaceId` is not a UUID or `window` is not one of 1d, 7d, 30d. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `auth.read` on the workspace (including non-members), or Auth is not enabled on it (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Workspace not found. Today an unknown workspace answers 403 like every other workspace route, so callers cannot probe which ids exist. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const authWorkspaceStats = await auth.stats.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-stats)

## webhooks

### `auth.webhooks.unwrap({ payload, headers, secret? })`

Verifies the signature and returns `Auth.UnwrapWebhookEvent`. Events: `app.slug_changed`, `tenant.created`, `tenant.deleted`, `tenant.invite.accepted`, `tenant.invite.created`, `tenant.invite.revoked`, `tenant.member.added`, `tenant.member.removed`, `tenant.member.role_changed`, `tenant.updated`, `user.contact_verified`, `user.deactivated`, `user.deleted`, `user.email_verified`, `user.mfa.enrollment_required`, `user.mfa.factor_disabled`, `user.mfa.factor_enrolled`, `user.mfa.recovery_code_used`, `user.mfa.reenrollment_required`, `user.mfa.step_up_locked`, `user.mfa.step_up_succeeded`, `user.password_reset.completed`, `user.password_reset.requested`, `user.reinstated`, `user.role_changed`, `user.signin`, `user.signup`, `user.suspended`, plus `UnknownWebhookEvent` for types added later.

### `auth.webhooks.sign({ payload, secret?, id?, timestamp? })`

Signs a test event exactly as ProductCraft signs deliveries (Standard Webhooks) and returns `{ payload, headers }`, ready for `unwrap` or a request to your handler. For tests; real deliveries come signed.

## admin.app(…)

### `auth.admin.app(…).clone(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/clone` → `Auth.CloneApp`

Create a second app in the same workspace whose configuration matches this one — the "staging app" flow. Copies the auth config, roles, permissions, notification settings and the webhook target (with a NEW signing secret), and optionally tenants. Never copies credentials, end-users, sessions, signing keys, federated provider configs or audit history.

- Params: `Auth.CloneParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure, or the slug matches the source. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.create` on the source app. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Source app not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Slug already taken (including as a live rename alias). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const cloneApp = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").clone({ environment: "staging", slug: "acme-app-staging" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-clone)

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/api-keys` → `Auth.CreateApiKey`

### `auth.admin.app(…).apiKeys.rotate(keyId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/api-keys/{key_id}/rotate` → `Auth.RotateApiKey`

Mint a replacement for an existing key, carrying its name and permissions over. The outgoing key keeps working for `grace_hours` (24 by default) so a fleet can roll over without downtime. The raw key is returned ONCE.

- Params: `Auth.ApiKeyRotateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No such key in this app. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | The key is revoked or already expired. There is nothing to roll over from — mint a new key instead. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const rotateApiKey = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").apiKeys.rotate("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { grace_hours: 24 });
```

## admin.app(…).auditLogs

### `auth.admin.app(…).auditLogs.export(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/apps/{app_id}/audit-logs/export` → `Response`

Stream this app's audit log as NDJSON or CSV, applying the same `?action=` / `?actor_id=` / `?since=` / `?until=` filters as the list. Newest first. Reading the export is itself audited as `audit.exported`.

The response is streamed: rows are walked in keyset batches and written as they are read, so neither the service nor the client has to hold the whole result set. Works on both lanes — a platform bearer token and a `pcft_live_*` Platform API Key with `auth.audit.read` hit the same route. Hard cap of 1,000,000 rows per call; a wider request is refused with 413 before any body is written, so a truncated file can never masquerade as a complete one.

- Params: `Auth.AuditLogExportParams`
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Unknown `format`, or malformed `since` / `until`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.audit.read`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found or caller is not a member. |
| 413 | `APIError` | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | More than 1,000,000 rows match. Narrow the window with `since` / `until` (or a tighter `action` / `actor_id` filter) and retry. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const response = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").auditLogs.export();
const text = await response.text();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-v1-apps-app-id-audit-logs-export)

Append-only audit log for this app, newest first. Filter by `?action=`, `?actor_id=`, and/or the `?since=` / `?until=` date range. 20/page (max 100), cursor-paginated.

- Params: `Auth.AuditLogListParams`

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |

| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found or caller is not a member. |

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |

### `auth.admin.app(…).auditSink.replace(params, options?)`

`PUT /v1/apps/{app_id}/audit-sink` → `Auth.AuditSinkWithSecret`

Create or replace the audit sink. Returns a freshly generated signing secret exactly once.

Audit rows are POSTed in batches of up to 100, signed with the same `X-Auth-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` HMAC header as the outbound webhooks. Delivery is at-least-once: the cursor advances only after a 2xx, so a batch that times out after the receiver processed it is re-sent. Every record carries its immutable `audit_log` id, so dedupe on that. A new sink starts from the moment it is created — configuring one does not replay the existing history into your SIEM. Replacing an existing sink clears the auto-disabled state (the same "I fixed my receiver" signal a webhook PUT carries) but does NOT rewind the cursor.

- Params: `Auth.AuditSinkReplaceParams`
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | URL is not HTTPS, or the SSRF guard refused it (private address, unresolvable host, non-public TLD). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const auditSink = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").auditSink.replace({ url: "https://siem.customer.example.com/ingest/productcraft-auth" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#put-v1-apps-app-id-audit-sink)

### `auth.admin.app(…).auditSink.rotateSecret(options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/audit-sink/rotate-secret` → `Auth.AuditSinkWithSecret`

Issue a new signing secret, returned exactly once.

The new secret signs every batch from now on; the old one stops at once. Update your receiver right away: batches it rejects in between are retried every minute (the position only moves after a 2xx), so nothing is lost, but export stops after 20 failures in a row. Clears the receiver-test proof.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No audit sink configured. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const auditSink = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").auditSink.rotateSecret();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-audit-sink-rotate-secret)

### `auth.admin.app(…).auditSink.setupStatus(options?)`

`GET /v1/apps/{app_id}/audit-sink/setup-status` → `Auth.SetupStatus`

Get the audit export checklist: destination, receiver test and delivery.

Rows, in order: `destination` (not_set until a sink exists), `test_batch` (pass once the receiver accepted a test batch with the current address and secret; blocked when the last test was refused; carries `test.action: audit_sink.test`, run with `POST /v1/apps/{appId}/audit-sink/test`), and `delivery` (blocked when export stopped after repeated failures, attention while paused or while recent batches fail). Computed from the stored sink on every request; answers 200 whether or not a sink exists.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.read`, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const setupStatus = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").auditSink.setupStatus();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-v1-apps-app-id-audit-sink-setup-status)

### `auth.admin.app(…).auditSink.test(options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/audit-sink/test` → `Auth.AuditSinkTestResult`

Send a test batch to the receiver now and report what it answered.

POSTs one signed batch, shaped exactly like a real one (`type: audit.batch`, same headers and signature), with `test: true` and a single synthetic record whose `id` starts with `test_`. Works while export is paused or stopped, so a fix can be proven before export is turned back on. The outcome is recorded on the sink (`last_attempt_*`, `last_test_succeeded_at`) but never moves the position in the audit log or counts toward the automatic stop. A refused test is still a 200 with `delivered: false`. At most 20 tests per app per hour.

- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No audit sink configured. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 tests for this app in the last hour (`RATE_LIMITED`). |

```ts
const auditSinkTestResult = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").auditSink.test();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-audit-sink-test)

### `auth.admin.app(…).auditSink.update(params?, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/apps/{app_id}/audit-sink` → `Auth.AuditSink`

Change the address or switch export on or off, keeping the signing secret.

Send `url`, `enabled` or both. `enabled: false` pauses export; `enabled: true` resumes it and clears a stop after repeated failures and the failure count. The position in the audit log is never moved: nothing is skipped and nothing is replayed twice on purpose. A new `url` is checked by the same address guard as `PUT`.

- Params: `Auth.AuditSinkUpdateParams`

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No audit sink configured. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const auditSink = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").auditSink.update({ enabled: true });
```

## admin.app(…).authConfig.providers

### `auth.admin.app(…).authConfig.providers.check(provider, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/auth-config/providers/{provider}/check` → `Auth.ProviderCheck`

Check the saved provider credentials with the provider.

Calls the provider's token endpoint with a dummy sign-in code. If the provider refuses the client (`invalid_client`, GitHub `incorrect_client_credentials` or `unknown_client`), the result is `credentials_rejected` and the provider shows as `blocked` with reason `credentials_rejected` until the credentials are fixed. If it only refuses the code (`invalid_grant`, `bad_verification_code`), the credentials are valid. Nobody is signed in. The result is saved on the provider (`last_check_*`). The same check runs automatically whenever the credentials are saved. Works for a provider that is saved but not switched on yet.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Unknown provider id, or the saved config can no longer be read. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found, or the provider is not configured for this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const providerCheck = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").authConfig.providers.check("google");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-auth-config-providers-provider-check)

```ts
const m2mRotateSecret = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").credentials.rotate("m2m_a1b2c3d4e5f6");
```

## admin.app(…).customDomains

### `auth.admin.app(…).customDomains.apply(domainId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/custom-domains/{domain_id}/apply` → `Auth.CustomDomainApplyResult`

Set up the custom domain's DNS records in one step with a short-lived Cloudflare or DigitalOcean API token.

Reads the zone through the provider's API and plans both records: `create`, or `skip` when already there. Nothing is ever changed or deleted, and only names at or under the custom host are written (Cloudflare records are DNS-only, not proxied). Anything in the way (another CNAME at the host, A/MX/TXT records where the CNAME must go) refuses the whole apply with 409 and the plan, before anything is written. `dry_run: true` returns the plan and changes nothing; `dry_run: false` writes exactly that plan and runs a check straight away (the records are usually `propagating` for a few minutes). The token is used for this request only: never stored, logged, queued or returned; revoke it afterwards (`warnings` says so when it could see more than this zone).

- Params: `Auth.CustomDomainApplyParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, `INVALID_ZONE`, `PROVIDER_TOKEN_REJECTED`, `PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED`, `PROVIDER_ZONE_NOT_FOUND`, `APEX_NOT_SUPPORTED` | Validation failure; `Idempotency-Key` missing (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`); `zone` is not the host or a parent (`INVALID_ZONE`); the provider rejected the token (`PROVIDER_TOKEN_REJECTED`), it lacks DNS rights (`PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED`), or it cannot see a zone for the host (`PROVIDER_ZONE_NOT_FOUND`); the host is a zone root (`APEX_NOT_SUPPORTED`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND` | App or custom domain not found (`CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `DNS_CONFLICTS`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `DNS_CONFLICTS`: something at the names blocks a record. Nothing was written; the body carries the full `plan` and `conflicts` next to `code` and `message`. Or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 502 | `InternalServerError` | `BAD_GATEWAY`, `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`, `PROVIDER_ERROR` | The provider failed or did not answer (`PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`, `PROVIDER_ERROR`). Nothing was written unless the plan items say so. |

```ts
const customDomainApplyResult = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").customDomains.apply("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { dry_run: true, provider: "cloudflare", token: "cf-token-from-your-dashboard" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-custom-domains-domain-id-apply)

### `auth.admin.app(…).customDomains.check(domainId, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/custom-domains/{domain_id}/check` → `Auth.CustomDomain`

Check the custom domain's DNS records now.

Asks the zone's own nameservers and a public resolver for both records, stores each record's state and conflicts, and moves the status: `active` once both are verified; an active domain turns `failing` only when a record is definitely gone or blocked (a DNS outage never takes a working domain down). Safe to repeat.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `domainId` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND` | App or custom domain not found (`CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const customDomain = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").customDomains.check("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-custom-domains-domain-id-check)

### `auth.admin.app(…).customDomains.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/custom-domains` → `Auth.CustomDomain`

Add a custom domain (such as auth.acme.com) for this app's sign-in.

Returns the two records to publish: a CNAME from the host to `edge_target`, and a TXT token at `_productcraft-auth.<host>` that proves the domain is yours. The zone and its DNS provider are detected, and the first check runs straight away, so `records[].state` and `conflicts` already say what is missing or in the way. Publish the records by hand, import `…/export`, or let `…/apply` write them with a short-lived provider token. The domain turns `active` once both records are seen. Sign-in tokens keep the canonical issuer (`https://api.auth.productcraft.co/{slug}`), so nothing changes for code that verifies them. One custom domain per app. While the feature is in early access it is switched on per workspace.

- Params: `Auth.CustomDomainCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INVALID_HOSTNAME`, `HOSTNAME_RESERVED`, `APEX_NOT_SUPPORTED` | Not a usable host name (`INVALID_HOSTNAME`), one of ours (`HOSTNAME_RESERVED`), or the root of a DNS zone, which cannot hold a CNAME (`APEX_NOT_SUPPORTED`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `auth.update` on this app, the app is suspended or archived, or custom domains are not switched on for the workspace (`FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_EXISTS`, `HOSTNAME_TAKEN`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | The app already has a custom domain (`CUSTOM_DOMAIN_EXISTS`), the host is set up on another app (`HOSTNAME_TAKEN`), or the Idempotency-Key was reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const customDomain = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").customDomains.create({ hostname: "auth.acme.com" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-custom-domains)

### `auth.admin.app(…).customDomains.delete(domainId, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/apps/{app_id}/custom-domains/{domain_id}` → `void`

Remove the custom domain.

The host stops serving this app at once and its certificate is no longer renewed. Your DNS records are not touched: delete the CNAME and the `_productcraft-auth` TXT record at your DNS provider. Sign-ins on the canonical host are unaffected.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `domainId` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND` | App or custom domain not found (`CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").customDomains.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#delete-v1-apps-app-id-custom-domains-domain-id)

### `auth.admin.app(…).customDomains.export(domainId, params, options?)`

`GET /v1/apps/{app_id}/custom-domains/{domain_id}/export` → `Response`

Download the custom domain's DNS records as a BIND zone fragment or a CSV.

`format=bind`: a zone-file fragment (`$ORIGIN <zone>.`, `$TTL 3600`, names relative to the zone, a comment per record with its purpose and any conflict) that Cloudflare and Route 53 import directly. `format=csv`: `type,name,value,priority,ttl,purpose,required`, fully qualified names. By default only records not verified yet; `all=true` for both. Served as an attachment.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `INVALID_FORMAT` | `format` missing or not `bind` / `csv` (`INVALID_FORMAT`), or `domainId` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.read` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND` | App or custom domain not found (`CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const response = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").customDomains.export("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { format: "bind" });

```

## admin.app(…).endUsers

### `auth.admin.app(…).endUsers.bulkDelete(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/end-users/bulk-delete` → `Auth.BulkAffectedUsers`

Bulk-delete accounts across a selection.

Deletes every matched account in one transaction. Each deleted account gets an `auth.account.deleted` audit row (`via: platform_bulk`) whose metadata carries the `selection` (`{ mode: "ids" }`, or `{ mode: "filter", filter }`), so a filter sweep reads as one. The workspace audit log gets one `auth.end_users.deleted` row with the count. `user.deleted` (`via: "platform_bulk"`) fires per account only when 100 or fewer were deleted.

- Params: `Auth.EndUserBulkDeleteParams`
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid `selection` body, or an unfiltered selection without `confirm_all_in_app: true` (including more than 5,000 ids). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.delete` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const bulkAffectedUsers = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").endUsers.bulkDelete({ selection: { mode: "ids" } });
```

### `auth.admin.app(…).endUsers.export(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/apps/{app_id}/end-users/export` → `Response`

Stream this app's end-user directory as NDJSON or CSV, applying the list's `?status=` / `?search=` / `?provider=` filters. Audited as `users.exported`.

Streamed in keyset batches — neither the service nor the client holds the whole directory. Ordered oldest-first by `(created_at, id)` so a re-run is stable. Gated on `auth.user.export`, which is escalation class: this hands over every address in the directory in one call, where `auth.list` pages it. ## admin.app(…).endUsers.imports

### `auth.admin.app(…).endUsers.imports.create(options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/end-users/import` → `Auth.ImportJob`

Queue a bulk end-user import. Body is NDJSON — one JSON object per line. Returns 202 with a job id; poll `GET .../import/:jobId` for progress and the per-row error report.

Row fields: `email` (required), `username`, `display_name`, `role`, `tenant_slugs` (array), `external_id`, `metadata`, `email_verified`, and `password_hash` + `password_hash_algorithm`.  `password_hash_algorithm` is `argon2id` or `bcrypt`. **argon2id** hashes are accepted at any parameters. **bcrypt** hashes (`$2a$`, `$2b$`, `$2y$` — Auth0, PHP `password_hash`, Spring, node `bcrypt`, Devise / Rails, Laravel, Django) are accepted at any valid cost (4-31), verified on the user's first signin and replaced by an argon2id hash of the same password in that request, so the user keeps their password and never notices. Signin pads a bcrypt verify up to the argon2id floor, so at cost 10 and below an imported account cannot be told apart by timing; at cost 11 and above the verify is slower than the floor and answers when it finishes — a small timing difference on migrated accounts only, gone after each one's first signin.  A re-run is idempotent: rows match on `external_id` first, then the primary email, and update rather than duplicate. An existing password, an already-verified address and an existing member's role are never overwritten — see the module docs for why each one.

- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Body is empty or contains no NDJSON rows. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.user.import`. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 413 | `APIError` | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | Body exceeds 20 MiB or 50,000 rows. Split and retry. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const importJob = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").endUsers.imports.create();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-end-users-import)

### `auth.admin.app(…).endUsers.imports.retrieve(jobId, options?)`

`GET /v1/apps/{app_id}/end-users/import/{job_id}` → `Auth.ImportJob`

Import job status and per-row error report. Never returns the uploaded file.

`status: succeeded` means the job RAN TO COMPLETION, not that every row landed — read `failed_count` and `errors` for that. `errors` is capped at the first 500 entries; the counts stay exact.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.user.import`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No such import job in this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const importJob = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").endUsers.imports.retrieve("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

## admin.app(…).endUsers.mfa

### `auth.admin.app(…).endUsers.mfa.requireReenrollment(userId, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/end-users/{user_id}/mfa/require-reenrollment` → `Auth.RequireMfaReenrollment`

Force an end-user back through MFA enrolment.

Disables every enabled factor on the account, destroys its recovery codes, and revokes every live session. The next sign-in on an app running `auth_config.mfa: "required"` returns `mfa_enrollment_required` and the user must enrol a new factor before a session is minted. On an app running `mfa: "optional"` the user simply ends up with no MFA, which is the pre-existing meaning of deleting their factors. All three steps matter: leaving the recovery codes alive would let whoever holds the old printout complete `/auth/mfa/recover` and skip enrolment entirely. Audited, and emits `user.mfa.factor_disabled` per factor plus one `user.mfa.reenrollment_required`. Idempotent.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller's workspace policy does not allow `auth.user.factors.delete` on this app. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No such end-user in this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const requireMfaReenrollment = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").endUsers.mfa.requireReenrollment("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-end-users-user-id-mfa-require-reenrollment)

Read the per-app notification settings. Absent row reads as defaults (notifications_via_envoi: false, sender_mode: workspace, every template slot null).

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |

### `auth.admin.app(…).notificationSettings.update(params?, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/apps/{app_id}/notification-settings` → `Auth.AppNotificationSettings`

Update the per-app notification settings. Each field is independently optional; null clears that slot.

Turning `notifications_via_envoi` on (from off) creates the default template of every empty slot in the workspace's Mail templates (`auth-verification`, `auth-welcome`, `auth-password-reset`, `auth-invite`, `auth-mfa-code`), reusing a template that already has that name, and fills the slot. Templates are created with your own Mail access; a slot that could not be created stays empty. A slot you clear later is not refilled until emails are switched off and on again.

- Params: `Auth.NotificationSettingUpdateParams`
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid payload. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `SENDER_ADDRESS_REQUIRED` | `SENDER_ADDRESS_REQUIRED`: `sender_mode: custom` with no `default_sender_address` (in the body or already saved). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const appNotificationSettings = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").notificationSettings.update({ default_sender_address: "ada@example.com" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#patch-v1-apps-app-id-notification-settings)

## admin.app(…).notifications

### `auth.admin.app(…).notifications.test(slot, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/notifications/{slot}/test` → `Auth.NotificationTest`

Send me a test of one email.

Sends the slot's real Mail template, with this app's real sender (the workspace default or the custom address) and example values for every variable, to your own verified account address. It cannot be sent anywhere else. It uses your own Mail access, goes through the same send path as real emails, and shows up in Mail > Emails. At most 10 tests per person per hour. Not available to API keys (a key has no inbox).

- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Unknown `slot`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update` on this app, the app is suspended or archived, or Mail refused the send for your role (you need Mail send access in this workspace). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found, or the slot's template no longer exists in Mail. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 412 | `APIError` | `PRECONDITION_FAILED`, `ENVOI_TEMPLATE_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `ENVOI_SENDER_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `ENVOI_APP_NOT_BOUND_TO_WORKSPACE` | `ENVOI_TEMPLATE_NOT_CONFIGURED`: the slot has no template. `ENVOI_SENDER_NOT_CONFIGURED`: `sender_mode: custom` with no address. `ENVOI_APP_NOT_BOUND_TO_WORKSPACE`. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | `operator_email_unavailable`: the caller has no verified account email (API keys included). From Mail: `no_default_sender` (workspace mode and no default sender set in Mail), `from_domain_not_verified`, `domain_not_verified_by_provider`, a suppressed address, or a render failure. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 10 tests by you in the last hour (`RATE_LIMITED`), or over a Mail send limit. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `MAIL_UNREACHABLE` | `MAIL_UNREACHABLE`: Mail did not answer. |

```ts
const notificationTest = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").notifications.test("verification");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-notifications-slot-test)

## admin.app(…).setupStatus

### `auth.admin.app(…).setupStatus.retrieve(options?)`

`GET /v1/apps/{app_id}/setup-status` → `Auth.SetupStatus`

Get the setup checklist for an app: what works, what is missing, and where to fix it.

Rows, in order: `signups` (attention while sign-ups are off), `redirect_origins` (blocked until at least one site may start sign-in), one `provider_<id>` row per switched-on sign-in provider (blocked while its status is blocked), `email` (sender chosen and a template for every email; attention while emails are off), `api_key` (attention until an active app key exists), `webhook` (attention until an endpoint has accepted a delivery), and `passkeys` (only while passkeys are on; blocked when no allowed redirect origin is on the passkey site). `complete` is true once no row is `not_set` or `blocked`. Each `fix.href` is a console path to the exact setting. Computed on every request from stored settings, plus the workspace default sender read from Mail with your own access when emails use it: nothing here calls DNS or a sign-in provider (a provider whose last credential check was rejected shows as blocked). A ready provider row carries `test.action: sign_in.try`: run it with `POST /v1/apps/{appId}/sign-in-tests` `{ method: "oauth", provider }`.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.read` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const setupStatus = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").setupStatus.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-v1-apps-app-id-setup-status)

## admin.app(…).signInTests

### `auth.admin.app(…).signInTests.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/sign-in-tests` → `Auth.SignInTest`

Start a sign-in test: prove sign-in works without creating a user.

For `oauth`, the server first checks what it can on its own (an allowed redirect origin, saved credentials, and the provider credential check). If one fails, the test comes back `failed` at once with the fix. Otherwise open `start_url` in a popup: the person signs in at the provider, the provider returns to Auth, Auth resolves who it is exactly as a real sign-in would, records `would_sign_in_existing` or `would_create` (or the provider error mapped to its fix), creates no account and issues no token, then sends the popup to the console result page. Poll `GET …/sign-in-tests/{id}` until `state` is not `pending`. Works with a provider that is saved but not switched on yet. For `password` / `otp`, the test runs now: it checks the sign-up or sign-in rules for your own email and sends the real email to your own verified address. At most 20 tests per app per hour; tests are deleted after 24 hours.

- Params: `Auth.SignInTestCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_OAUTH_ONLY` | Unknown `method` or provider, `provider` missing for `oauth`, or `custom_domain` on a `password` / `otp` test (`CUSTOM_DOMAIN_OAUTH_ONLY`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.update` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_ACTIVE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`), or `custom_domain: true` while the app has no active custom domain (`CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_ACTIVE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 tests for this app in the last hour (`RATE_LIMITED`). |

```ts
const signInTest = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").signInTests.create({ method: "oauth" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-sign-in-tests)

### `auth.admin.app(…).signInTests.retrieve(testId, options?)`

`GET /v1/apps/{app_id}/sign-in-tests/{test_id}` → `Auth.SignInTest`

Get a sign-in test and its result.

Poll this after opening `start_url`. `state` turns `succeeded` (with `outcome` and `identity`) or `failed` (with `error.fix`). A test that is never finished turns `failed` with code `expired` 15 minutes after it was created.

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `testId` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.read` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App or sign-in test not found (tests are deleted after 24 hours). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const signInTest = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").signInTests.retrieve("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-v1-apps-app-id-sign-in-tests-test-id)

Change the app's tenant API key settings, or suspend its keys.

Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

### `auth.admin.app(…).unverifiedAccountExpiry.run(params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/unverified-account-expiry/run` → `Auth.UnverifiedAccountExpiryRun`

Run the unverified-account expiry for this app now (or as a dry run).

Permanently deletes every account that qualifies under the app's `unverified_account_ttl_days`, exactly as the nightly job does: each deletion is audited as `auth.account.expired_unverified` and fires `user.deleted` with `reason: "unverified_expired"`. Use `dry_run: true` to preview.

- Params: `Auth.UnverifiedAccountExpiryRunParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failure (`min_age_minutes` out of range). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.delete` on this app, or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Expiry is off for this app and the request is not a dry run. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | `min_age_minutes` was sent for an app that is not a development app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const unverifiedAccountExpiryRun = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").unverifiedAccountExpiry.run({ dry_run: false });
```

## admin.app(…).webhooks.endpoints

### `auth.admin.app(…).webhooks.endpoints.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/webhooks/endpoints` → `Auth.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Add a webhook endpoint. Returns its signing secret once.

Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>">`); the returned `whsec_…` secret works unchanged with any Standard Webhooks library. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 24 h.

- Params: `Auth.WebhookEndpointCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | Validation failure: URL not https with a public host, or an unknown event type (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller lacks `auth.read` (reads) or `auth.update` (changes, Send test, replay), or the app is suspended or archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Already 10 endpoints (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await auth.admin.app("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f").webhooks.endpoints.create({ url: "https://api.acme.com/webhooks" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-v1-apps-app-id-webhooks-endpoints)

## consumer(…)

### `auth.consumer(…).acceptInvite(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/accept-invite` → `Auth.AcceptInviteResponse`

Accept an EndUser invite by code.

Materialises a pre-allocated invite into a real EndUser: creates account + primary email contact (verified, since mailing the code proved control) + password credential + role membership, then mints app-scoped tokens. Public endpoint — the invite code is the authority. 410 on revoked/expired/exhausted invites; 409 on duplicate email or username. The same password policy as `/auth/signup` applies, including the common-password deny-list and the breach check, and so does the app-level MFA mandate: on an `auth_config.mfa: "required"` app the account is created but the response is `mfa_enrollment_required: true` with no session behind it.

- Params: `Auth.AcceptInviteParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app exists but is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). Decided by `AppStatusGuard` before the handler runs. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Invite code not found in this app, or the `:appSlug` matches no app at all. Deliberately the same status — neither says anything about accounts. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT` | Email or username already in use. |
| 410 | `APIError` | `GONE` | Invite revoked, expired, or fully used. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `default` bucket — 60 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service is momentarily busy (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`): too many password hashes or verifications are already running or queued on the instance that took the request. Nothing was changed and no attempt was counted. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (also in `details.retry_after_seconds`). Decided by instance load only, never by the identifier or the account, so it reveals nothing about whether an account exists. |

```ts
const result = await auth.consumer("my-app").acceptInvite({ code: "inv_x7H2k3jLqXr", password: "CorrectHorseBatteryStaple" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-accept-invite)

### `auth.consumer(…).acceptTenantInvite(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/accept-tenant-invite` → `Auth.ConsumerToken`

Accept a tenant invite by code.

Materialises a pending `tenant_invite` into a real EndUser: creates account + verified primary email contact (mailing the code proved control of the address) + password credential + an app-level membership on the app's signup default role + a tenant membership on the role the invite names, then mints a session already scoped to that tenant, so the access token carries `org_id` / `org_role` with no follow-up switch-tenant call. Public endpoint — the invite code is the authority. 410 on revoked/expired/exhausted invites. **409 when an account already exists for the invited address**: this endpoint will not set a password on, or mint a session for, an account it did not create, because the plaintext code is also held by whoever minted the invite. Existing users sign in and call `POST /:appSlug/v1/me/tenant-invites/accept` instead, which adds the membership without touching credentials.

- Params: `Auth.AcceptTenantInviteParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app exists but is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). Decided by `AppStatusGuard` before the handler runs. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Invite code not found in this app, or the `:appSlug` matches no app at all. Deliberately the same status — neither says anything about accounts. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `ACCOUNT_EXISTS` | An account already exists for the invited address (`ACCOUNT_EXISTS`), or the requested username is taken. |
| 410 | `APIError` | `GONE` | Invite revoked, expired, or fully used. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `default` bucket — 60 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service is momentarily busy (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`): too many password hashes or verifications are already running or queued on the instance that took the request. Nothing was changed and no attempt was counted. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (also in `details.retry_after_seconds`). Decided by instance load only, never by the identifier or the account, so it reveals nothing about whether an account exists. |

```ts
const consumerToken = await auth.consumer("my-app").acceptTenantInvite({ code: "tinv_9dK2mQ7pR4vXbN1sT6yZ0hLcJeW3fAgU", password: "CorrectHorseBatteryStaple" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-accept-tenant-invite)

### `auth.consumer(…).logout(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/logout` → `void`

Revoke a refresh token.

Destroys the session that owns the refresh token. The matching access token continues to verify until its TTL expires.

- Params: `Auth.LogoutParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | The refresh token matches no session. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app exists but is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). Decided by `AppStatusGuard` before the handler runs. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`).
