### `auth.consumer(…).signin(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/signin` → `Auth.SigninResponse`

Sign in an EndUser.

Authenticate with username or verified primary email + password. When the account has no enabled MFA factors, returns a fresh access + refresh token pair (`ConsumerTokenResponseDto` shape). When the account has any enabled factor, returns an MFA challenge instead (`ConsumerMfaChallengeResponseDto` shape, `mfa_required: true`). In that case no session has been created yet — complete the challenge via `POST /auth/mfa/verify` (or `/auth/mfa/recover`) to receive the token pair. When the app runs `auth_config.mfa: "required"` and the account has NO enabled factor, returns a third shape (`ConsumerMfaEnrollmentRequiredResponseDto`, `mfa_enrollment_required: true`) — again no session — which is completed via `POST /auth/mfa/enroll` + `/auth/mfa/enroll/verify`. Inside `mfa_grace_days` of account creation that case instead returns the ordinary token pair with `mfa_enrollment_due_at` set.

- Params: `Auth.SigninParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Invalid credentials. Returned for every failed attempt, whatever went wrong: a wrong password, an identifier that matches no account, an account with no password credential, an account locked out through a different identifier, an account an operator has blocked, and a wrong password against a suspended or deactivated account. The responses are deliberately identical in body, timing, DB round trips and Redis ops, so signin is not an account-existence oracle. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Signin is disabled for this app, or the account is suspended / deactivated. The account-status refusal is only reachable once the caller has proven the password — a wrong password against such an account is a 401. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many failed attempts. Two counters produce it, both keyed purely by the submitted identifier: a burst limit of 5 attempts per minute, and a 15-minute lock after the app's `max_failed_login_attempts` failures (default 5). Both fire on the same attempt for a registered and an unregistered identifier. The lock threshold was a fixed 4 until the knob was wired up in tasks/users-api/014. Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `auth` bucket — 10 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service is momentarily busy (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`): too many password hashes or verifications are already running or queued on the instance that took the request. Nothing was changed and no attempt was counted. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (also in `details.retry_after_seconds`). Decided by instance load only, never by the identifier or the account, so it reveals nothing about whether an account exists. |

```ts
const result = await auth.consumer("my-app").signin({ identifier: "jane_doe", password: "correct horse battery staple" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-signin)

### `auth.consumer(…).signinWithProvider(provider, params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/oauth/{provider}` → `Auth.SigninWithProviderResponse`

Sign in / sign up with a provider ID token (native flow).

Submit the provider-issued ID token from a native client (iOS ASAuthorizationController, Google Sign-In for iOS / Android). Backend verifies the token signature, issuer, audience (against this app's configured native client ids), and nonce binding; consumes the nonce server-side to defeat in-window replay; resolves or creates the Auth account; mints access + refresh tokens with `amr=["oauth", "<provider>"]`. Same response shape as `/auth/signin`.

- Params: `Auth.SigninWithProviderParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | ID token verification failed (bad signature / issuer / audience / nonce / expired). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `link_required`, `account_exists_with_different_provider` | Email collides with an existing account. Response carries an error `code` of `link_required` (when the app's policy is `confirm`) or `account_exists_with_different_provider` (when `reject`). Sign in with the original method to link. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const signin = await auth.consumer("my-app").signinWithProvider("google", {
  id_token: "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImsxIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c3JfMSJ9.c2lnbmF0dXJl",
  nonce: "n-0S6_WzA2Mj",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-oauth-provider)

### `auth.consumer(…).signup(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/signup` → `Auth.SignupResponse`

Sign up an EndUser.

Create an EndUser account inside the app and immediately mint a session. The supplied email becomes the primary email contact, unverified at signup. When the app has completed Mail notification setup, a verification code is auto-emailed to the address; customers delivering their own verification messages call /auth/request-verification (or /auth/send-verification-email) instead — doing so invalidates the auto-sent code, so the user only ever has one valid code. Subject to the app-configured signup policy (signup enabled, password policy, default role, optional `signup_requires_pak`). The password must clear the app's length + character-class rules, a common-password deny-list, and — unless the app sets `password_breach_check` to `warn` or `off` — a public breach corpus; a breached password is refused with 400 `PASSWORD_BREACHED` and a deny-listed one with 400 `PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON`. The breach lookup is k-anonymous (only five characters of the password's SHA-1 leave the service) and fails open, so an unreachable corpus never blocks a signup.

When the app runs `auth_config.mfa: "required"`, the account is still created but NO session is minted: the response is the `ConsumerMfaEnrollmentRequiredResponseDto` shape (`mfa_enrollment_required: true`), completed via `POST /auth/mfa/enroll` + `/auth/mfa/enroll/verify`. Inside `mfa_grace_days` of account creation — which a fresh signup always is when the window is non-zero — the ordinary token pair is returned with `mfa_enrollment_due_at` set instead.

When the app has bot protection on (`auth_config.bot_protection`, Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha), send the widget response as `bot_protection_token`. Auth verifies it with the provider before it looks at the email, username or password, and refuses the sign-up when the token is missing (400 `BOT_PROTECTION_REQUIRED`), rejected (403 `BOT_PROTECTION_FAILED`) or cannot be checked (503 `BOT_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE`; no account is created). This applies to PAK-authenticated calls too: a backend forwards the token its browser received.

- Params: `Auth.SignupParams`
- Credential (optional): [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `BOT_PROTECTION_REQUIRED` | `BOT_PROTECTION_REQUIRED`: the app has bot protection on and the request carried no `bot_protection_token`. Also: Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | The app sets `signup_requires_pak` and no Platform API Key was presented on `Authorization: Bearer`. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `BOT_PROTECTION_FAILED`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | `BOT_PROTECTION_FAILED`: the bot-protection provider rejected the `bot_protection_token` (bad, expired or already used), or the hostname it reported is not one of the app's `bot_protection.expected_hostnames`; render a fresh widget and retry. Otherwise: signup is disabled for this app (new apps start with `signup_enabled: false`; turn it on with `PATCH /v1/apps/{app_id}/auth-config`), the email domain is not on the app's allow-list, the presented PAK belongs to a different workspace, or its policy denies `auth.signup.create` on this app. Also returned when the app itself is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT` | Email or username already in use in this app, or the app has no workspace binding and therefore cannot accept a PAK signup. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `auth` bucket — 10 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, `BOT_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE` | `BOT_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE`: the app has bot protection on and the token could not be checked (the provider timed out or failed, or the app's bot-protection secret is missing or was refused by the provider). Sign-up fails closed: no account was created. Retry shortly. Otherwise: The service is momentarily busy (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`): too many password hashes or verifications are already running or queued on the instance that took the request. Nothing was changed and no attempt was counted. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (also in `details.retry_after_seconds`). Decided by instance load only, never by the identifier or the account, so it reveals nothing about whether an account exists. |

```ts
const result = await auth.consumer("my-app").signup({ email: "jane@example.com", password: "CorrectHorseBatteryStaple", username: "john_doe" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-signup)

### `auth.consumer(…).switchTenant(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/switch-tenant` → `Auth.ConsumerToken`

Switch the active tenant for this session.

Re-issues the EndUser's access + refresh tokens with the new `org_id` + `org_role` claims, after verifying the caller holds a tenant_membership for the target tenant. The session row is updated to the new tenant so subsequent refreshes preserve the context. The new access token keeps the session's `amr` and `mfa_at` (as `/auth/refresh` does), so a sign-in that completed MFA still proves it after a switch. Refresh-token rotation runs as usual; the previous refresh token enters the standard 60-second grace window.

- Params: `Auth.SwitchTenantParams`
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing / invalid bearer, the token carries no `sid`, or the session named by `sid` is revoked, expired or no longer exists. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller holds no membership in the target tenant, or the app is suspended / archived. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app, or `tenant_id` names no tenant in this app. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `default` bucket — 60 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const consumerToken = await auth.consumer("my-app").switchTenant({ tenant_id: "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-switch-tenant)

### `auth.consumer(…).verifyEmail(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/verify` → `Auth.ConsumerVerify`

Submit a verification code.

Consumes a 6-digit verification code (single-use) and flips the bound contact's `verified_at`. Public — anyone holding the code can submit it; that is the whole point of the verification flow. The server figures out which contact + account from the code value itself.

Renamed from /verify-email — the same endpoint now serves both email and phone verifications.

- Params: `Auth.VerifyEmailParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app exists but is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). Decided by `AppStatusGuard` before the handler runs. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 410 | `APIError` | `GONE` | Code invalid, expired, locked, or already consumed. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `verify_code` bucket — 5 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const consumerVerify = await auth.consumer("my-app").verifyEmail({ code: "123456" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-verify)

## consumer(…).me

### `auth.consumer(…).me.changePassword(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/me/change-password` → `void`

Change the password of the signed-in EndUser.

Verifies `current_password`, sets the new hash, and revokes every OTHER active session for the account (the calling session is preserved). 401 if the current password is wrong or the account has no password credential — admin-provisioned accounts without an initial password should use the reset flow instead. The new password is held to exactly the same policy as signup: the app's length + character-class rules, the common-password deny-list, and the breach corpus.

- Params: `Auth.MeChangePasswordParams`
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON`, `PASSWORD_BREACHED` | The new password fails the app-configured policy, is on the common-password deny-list (`PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON`), appears in a public breach corpus (`PASSWORD_BREACHED`), or is identical to the current one. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Current password incorrect or no credential. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service is momentarily busy (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`): too many password hashes or verifications are already running or queued on the instance that took the request. Nothing was changed and no attempt was counted. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (also in `details.retry_after_seconds`). Decided by instance load only, never by the identifier or the account, so it reveals nothing about whether an account exists. |

```ts
await auth.consumer("my-app").me.changePassword({
  current_password: "correct horse battery staple",
  new_password: "a new long passphrase 42",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-me-change-password)

### `auth.consumer(…).me.deleteAccount(options?)`

`DELETE /{app_slug}/v1/me` → `void`

Permanently delete the signed-in EndUser account.

Removes the EndUser, all sessions, and all related records inside this app. Cannot be undone. The app audit log keeps one `auth.account.deleted` row (`via: self`; username and email domain only, never the address), and `user.deleted` fires with `via: "self"`.

- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token, unknown or inactive app, or the account/session is no longer active. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await auth.consumer("my-app").me.deleteAccount();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#delete-app-slug-v1-me)

### `auth.consumer(…).me.deleteAvatar(options?)`

`DELETE /{app_slug}/v1/me/avatar` → `void`

Remove the EndUser avatar.

Clears both the uploaded avatar and any provider-captured picture, and deletes the stored object. A later Google/GitHub sign-in re-populates the provider picture — that is "sync from provider" behavior, by design.

- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token, unknown or inactive app, or the account/session is no longer active. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND` | Account not found in this app (`ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await auth.consumer("my-app").me.deleteAvatar();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#delete-app-slug-v1-me-avatar)

### `auth.consumer(…).me.permissions(options?)`

`GET /{app_slug}/v1/me/permissions` → `Auth.MePermissions`

Resolve the signed-in EndUser's effective permissions.

Returns the union of the app-level role permissions and the tenant-level role permissions (when the token carries an `org_id`). Resolved per-request through a 60-second LRU — role-permission edits propagate within ~1 minute. Use this instead of decoding a `permissions[]` claim from the JWT, which is no longer included. M2M tokens cannot call this — use `POST /:appSlug/v1/oauth/introspect` to inspect M2M scopes.

- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token, unknown or inactive app, or the account/session is no longer active. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const mePermissions = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.permissions();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-app-slug-v1-me-permissions)

### `auth.consumer(…).me.retrieve(options?)`

`GET /{app_slug}/v1/me` → `Auth.MeProfile`

Get the signed-in EndUser profile.

Returns the EndUser identity, app membership, and role name. The flat `permissions[]` array is intentionally NOT included — permissions resolve from the role on demand. Call `GET /me/permissions` for the flat list when the client needs it for UI gating.

- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Account not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const meProfile = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-app-slug-v1-me)

### `auth.consumer(…).me.update(params?, options?)`

`PATCH /{app_slug}/v1/me` → `Auth.MeUpdatedAccount`

Update the signed-in EndUser profile.

Editable fields: `display_name` and `username`. The username is unique per app (case-insensitive, same rule as signup); sending the current username is a no-op. Usernames cannot be cleared.

- Params: `Auth.MeUpdateParams`
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `USERNAME_TAKEN` | Requested username is already held by another account in this app (`USERNAME_TAKEN`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const meUpdatedAccount = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.update({ display_name: "Ada Lovelace" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#patch-app-slug-v1-me)

### `auth.consumer(…).me.uploadAvatar(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/me/avatar` → `Auth.AvatarUrl`

Upload (or replace) the EndUser avatar.

PNG/JPEG/WEBP only — SVG is rejected (stored-XSS vector). ≤2 MB. Magic bytes are sniffed; a mislabeled file is rejected. The image is re-encoded server-side (orientation baked in, all metadata incl. EXIF/GPS stripped, bounded to 512×512, webp). An uploaded avatar takes precedence over a provider-captured picture.

- Params: `Auth.MeUploadAvatarParams`
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 413 | `APIError` | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, `AVATAR_TOO_LARGE` | File exceeds 2 MB (`AVATAR_TOO_LARGE`). |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`, `AVATAR_INVALID_TYPE`, `AVATAR_MAGIC_MISMATCH` | Wrong mimetype, undecodable image, or content does not match the declared type (`AVATAR_INVALID_TYPE` / `AVATAR_MAGIC_MISMATCH`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const avatarUrl = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.uploadAvatar({ file: new File(["…"], "image.png", { type: "image/png" }) });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-me-avatar)

`GET /{app_slug}/v1/me/activity` → `PagePromise<Auth.MeActivityEntry>`

Recent account activity.

Login events, password changes, and other security-relevant records, scoped to this EndUser.

## consumer(…).me.contacts

### `auth.consumer(…).me.contacts.create(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/me/contacts` → `Auth.MeContact`

Add a new contact (unverified, non-primary).

Adds an email or phone contact to the EndUser. The contact starts unverified and non-primary. Verification is a separate flow — call /auth/request-verification with the contact value and the customer's PAK to mint a code, then submit via /auth/verify.

- Params: `Auth.MeContactCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: unsupported `type`, invalid email, or empty/over-long `value`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token, unknown or inactive app, or the account/session is no longer active. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Contact value already in use for this app. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): `/me/contacts` is in the strict `auth` bucket (10 requests per minute per IP). |

```ts
const meContact = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.contacts.create({ type: "email", value: "ada@example.com" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-me-contacts)

## consumer(…).me.mfa.factors

### `auth.consumer(…).me.mfa.factors.create(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/me/mfa/factors` → `Auth.StartEnrollment`

Begin enrollment of a new MFA factor.

Creates a pending factor and returns the type-specific enrollment payload. TOTP: the otpauth URI, QR data URL, and shared secret; confirm with two consecutive codes. Email: a 6-digit code is sent to the bound verified email contact (primary by default, `contact_id` to override); confirm with that single code. The factor stays disabled until `/factors/:id/verify` succeeds.

- Params: `Auth.MeMfaFactorCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: unsupported `type`, over-long `label`, or `contact_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token, unknown or inactive app, or the account/session is no longer active. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Email factors: `contact_id` names no email contact on this account. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 412 | `APIError` | `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | Email factors: the contact (or primary email) is unverified, or the app has not completed Mail setup for MFA codes. Passkeys: not enabled or not fully configured for this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const startEnrollment = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.mfa.factors.create({ type: "totp" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-me-mfa-factors)

### `auth.consumer(…).me.mfa.factors.delete(id, options?)`

`DELETE /{app_slug}/v1/me/mfa/factors/{id}` → `void`

Disable an MFA factor.

Soft-disable. The row is preserved (with `disabled_at` set) for audit. Has no effect on existing sessions — their `amr` claim still reflects whatever satisfied sign-in at the time. Disabling the only enabled factor removes the MFA requirement on future sign-ins.

- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token, unknown or inactive app, or the account/session is no longer active. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Factor not found on this account. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await auth.consumer("my-app").me.mfa.factors.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

## consumer(…).me.mfa.stepUp

### `auth.consumer(…).me.mfa.stepUp.sendCode(params?, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/me/mfa/step-up/send-code` → `Auth.StepUpSendCode`

Email a step-up code.

Mints a single-use 6-digit code against one of the account's enabled email factors and delivers it to the bound address. Follow with `/step-up` submitting the code. Codes expire after 5 minutes; sends are throttled per contact (30s between sends, shared with the sign-in path). Refused while step-up is locked on this session.

- Params: `Auth.MeMfaStepUpSendCodeParams`
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Account has no enabled email factor (or the named factor is not an email factor). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 410 | `APIError` | `GONE` | The bound email contact no longer exists or is no longer verified. |
| 412 | `APIError` | `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | The app has not completed Mail notification setup for MFA codes. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Send throttled, or step-up is locked on this session. |

```ts
const stepUpSendCode = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.mfa.stepUp.sendCode({ factor_id: "9b2f6c1e-0d6a-4a63-9a43-2f1c3e4d5a6b" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-me-mfa-step-up-send-code)

### `auth.consumer(…).me.mfa.stepUp.verify(params?, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/me/mfa/step-up` → `Auth.StepUp`

Bump this session's MFA recency.

Verify a fresh code (TOTP, emailed via `/step-up/send-code`, or recovery) against any enabled factor on the account, and update the session's `auth_methods` + `mfa_at`. Call `/auth/refresh` after this to mint a token whose claims reflect the new state. Customers reading `mfa_at` from access tokens to gate sensitive actions should require a `/step-up` + refresh cycle when the timestamp is older than their policy window. 5 consecutive wrong codes lock step-up on this session for 15 minutes.

- Params: `Auth.MeMfaStepUpVerifyParams`
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Code did not match any enabled factor or recovery code. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Step-up locked on this session after too many failures. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service is momentarily busy (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`): too many password hashes or verifications are already running or queued on the instance that took the request. Nothing was changed and no attempt was counted. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (also in `details.retry_after_seconds`). Decided by instance load only, never by the identifier or the account, so it reveals nothing about whether an account exists. |

```ts
const stepUp = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.mfa.stepUp.verify({ code: "123456" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-me-mfa-step-up)

## consumer(…).me.tenantInvites

### `auth.consumer(…).me.tenantInvites.accept(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/me/tenant-invites/accept` → `Auth.AcceptedTenantInvite`

Accept a tenant invite as the signed-in EndUser.

Adds the caller to the invited tenant with the role the invite names, and consumes the invite. Requires the invited address to be one of the caller's own VERIFIED email contacts in this app — holding the code is not sufficient, because whoever minted the invite also holds it, and an unverified contact is not proof of owning the address. A refused accept leaves the invite redeemable.

- Params: `Auth.MeTenantInviteAcceptParams`
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Two cases, told apart by `error.code`: `FORBIDDEN` — the invite was issued to an address that is not a contact of this account; `invite_email_unverified` — the invited address is a contact of this account but is not verified yet. Verify the address, then retry with the same code. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | No such invite in this app. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT` | Already a member of that tenant. |
| 410 | `APIError` | `GONE` | Invite revoked, expired, or fully used. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const acceptedTenantInvite = await auth.consumer("my-app").me.tenantInvites.accept({ code: "tinv_9dK2mQ7pR4vXbN1sT6yZ0hLcJeW3fAgU" });
```

## consumer(…).mfa

### `auth.consumer(…).mfa.enroll(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/mfa/enroll` → `Auth.StartEnrollment`

Begin MFA enrolment against an enrolment token.

For apps running `auth_config.mfa: "required"`. When a user proves their password but holds no enabled factor, `/auth/signin` returns `{ mfa_enrollment_required: true, mfa_token, expires_at }` and mints NO session; this endpoint starts the enrolment that `mfa_token` authorises. Same body and same response as `POST /{app_slug}/v1/me/mfa/factors`, but authenticated by the token rather than by a session — there is no session yet. TOTP returns the otpauth URI, QR data URL and shared secret; email sends a 6-digit code to the bound verified contact. The factor stays disabled until `/auth/mfa/enroll/verify` succeeds. The token is single-purpose: `/auth/mfa/verify`, `/auth/mfa/send-code` and `/auth/mfa/recover` all refuse it with 401, it is not an access token so `/me/*` refuses it, and `/auth/refresh` does not accept it.

- Params: `Auth.MfaEnrollParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Unsupported factor type, or the account already holds a factor. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Enrolment token invalid, expired, already used, or minted for a different app. A sign-in `mfa_token` (an MFA challenge, not an enrolment token) gets the same 401 — the response never says which kind of token was presented. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app exists but is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). Decided by `AppStatusGuard` before the handler runs. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 412 | `APIError` | `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | Email factor requested but the bound contact is unverified, or the app has not completed Mail notification setup. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `default` bucket — 60 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const startEnrollment = await auth.consumer("my-app").mfa.enroll({ mfa_token: "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", type: "totp" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-mfa-enroll)

This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many failed attempts against this challenge (5 locks it). Decided by instance load only, never by the identifier or the account, so it reveals nothing about whether an account exists. |

```ts
  mfa_token: "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
```

```ts
const consumerToken = await auth.consumer("my-app").mfa.verify({ mfa_token: "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-mfa-verify)

### `auth.consumer(…).mfa.verifyEnrollment(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/mfa/enroll/verify` → `Auth.ConsumerMfaEnrollVerify`

Confirm the enrolled factor and receive the withheld session.

Completes the flow started by `/auth/mfa/enroll`. TOTP: submit two `codes` from consecutive 30-second windows. Email: submit the emailed 6-digit `code`. On success the factor is enabled, a fresh set of recovery codes is minted and returned ONCE (invalidating any prior set), and the session sign-in withheld is finally minted with `amr: ["pwd","mfa"]` and `mfa_at` set to now. A wrong code counts against the token exactly as it does on the sign-in challenge; 5 failures lock it and the user must sign in again.

- Params: `Auth.MfaVerifyEnrollmentParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid or repeated codes, the factor is not pending, or the factor does not belong to the account the token was minted for. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Enrolment token invalid, expired, already used, or minted for a different app. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app exists but is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). Decided by `AppStatusGuard` before the handler runs. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many failed attempts against this enrolment token (5 locks it). Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `verify_code` bucket — 5 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const consumerMfaEnrollVerify = await auth.consumer("my-app").mfa.verifyEnrollment({
  factor_id: "9b2f6c1e-0d6a-4a63-9a43-2f1c3e4d5a6b",
  mfa_token: "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-mfa-enroll-verify)

## consumer(…).mfa.webauthn

### `auth.consumer(…).mfa.webauthn.options(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/mfa/webauthn/options` → `Auth.ConsumerWebauthnOptions`

Mints a single-use WebAuthn challenge scoped to the account behind `mfa_token` and returns the `publicKey` member for `navigator.credentials.get()`. Submit the result to `/auth/mfa/verify` as `credential` instead of `code`. Possession of the `mfa_token` (i.e. a correct password) is the authority — nothing here reveals whether an account exists or holds passkeys until that token has been presented.

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |

| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | No passkey is enrolled on the account behind this challenge. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Invalid or expired challenge. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app exists but is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). Decided by `AppStatusGuard` before the handler runs. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 412 | `APIError` | `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | Passkeys are not enabled, or no allowed redirect origin matches the configured relying-party id. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many failed attempts on the challenge. Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `default` bucket — 60 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const consumerWebauthnOptions = await auth.consumer("my-app").mfa.webauthn.options({ mfa_token: "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f" });
```

## consumer(…).oauth

### `auth.consumer(…).oauth.introspect(params?, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/oauth/introspect` → `Auth.Introspect`

Introspect the bearer access token (RFC 7662).

OAuth 2.0 token introspection. Send the access token via `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and receive either `{ active: false }` (invalid / expired / wrong app, or a session that is revoked, past its `expires_at`, or gone because the end user was deleted) or the active claim set including `scopes` (M2M) or `role` (EndUser), `exp`, `iat`, `iss`, `aid`. The body `token` field is optional and, if present, must match the bearer — RFC 7662 allows a separate `token` body field but we deliberately refuse cross-token introspection so a stolen token can't be probed against another active credential. The endpoint accepts both M2M and EndUser tokens — use it as the canonical way for a service to know what its own token can do, instead of decoding the JWT by hand. Returns 401 when the bearer is missing.

- Params: `Auth.OauthIntrospectParams`
- Credential: [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed in the global `ValidationPipe`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | No `Authorization: Bearer` header, or a `token` in the body that does not match the bearer. Every failure ABOUT THE TOKEN — bad signature, unknown / cross-app `kid`, wrong `aid`, expired, or a session that is revoked, past its `expires_at` or gone because the end user was deleted — is a 200 with `{ active: false }`, on purpose. A bad `:appSlug` is NOT one of those: it is a 404 (see below), decided by `AppStatusGuard` before this handler runs. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app. Raised by `AppStatusGuard`, which runs before the handler — so an introspection against a misspelled app slug is a 404, not an `{ active: false }`. About the **app**, decided before the token is parsed, so it says nothing about the token. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `default` bucket — 60 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const introspect = await auth.consumer("my-app").oauth.introspect({ token: "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImsxIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c3JfMSJ9.c2lnbmF0dXJl" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-oauth-introspect)

### `auth.consumer(…).oauth.token(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/oauth/token` → `Auth.OAuthToken`

Exchange client_credentials for an access token.

Standard OAuth 2.0 client_credentials grant. Returns an app-scoped access token whose `scopes[]` claim is the union of the client's configured scopes. Use for service-to-service calls.

- Params: `Auth.OauthTokenParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `grant_type` is missing or is not `client_credentials`, or request validation failed in the global `ValidationPipe`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | `Invalid client credentials`. The SINGLE answer for an unknown `client_id`, a deactivated client, a wrong secret and a credential whose stored hash predates the SHA-256 migration — identical in status, message, DB round trips, wall time and CPU cost, so the endpoint is neither a client-existence oracle nor a way for an anonymous caller to spend our CPU. If you need to know whether a credential was deactivated, read it on the authenticated admin surface; if a credential minted before the migration stopped working, rotate its secret. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app is suspended (`APP_SUSPENDED`) or archived (`APP_ARCHIVED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app. About the **app**, not the client — decided before `client_id` is looked at. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `token_exchange` bucket — 60 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const oAuthToken = await auth.consumer("my-app").oauth.token({
  client_id: "m2m_a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
  client_secret: "the-secret-returned-by-credentials-create",
  grant_type: "client_credentials",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-oauth-token)

## consumer(…).passkey

### `auth.consumer(…).passkey.options(params?, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/passkey/options` → `Auth.ConsumerWebauthnOptions`

Begin a passwordless passkey sign-in.

Returns a single-use WebAuthn challenge for `navigator.credentials.get()`. `allowCredentials` is ALWAYS empty and the response is shaped identically for every caller: this endpoint does not take an identifier and does not look one up, because returning a credential list for a registered address and an empty list for an unregistered one would be a single-request account-existence oracle. Sign-in therefore requires a discoverable (resident) credential — the authenticator finds its own passkey for the relying-party id. Submit the result to `/auth/passkey/verify`.

- Params: `Auth.PasskeyOptionsParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Signin is disabled for this app. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 412 | `APIError` | `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | Passkeys are not enabled, or no allowed redirect origin matches the configured relying-party id. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP burst limit. The endpoint does no credential work — one random challenge and one insert — so the bucket is the whole bound. Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `auth` bucket — 10 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const consumerWebauthnOptions = await auth.consumer("my-app").passkey.options({ tenant_id: "9b2f6c1e-0d6a-4a63-9a43-2f1c3e4d5a6b" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-passkey-options)

### `auth.consumer(…).passkey.verify(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/auth/passkey/verify` → `Auth.ConsumerToken`

Complete a passwordless passkey sign-in.

Verifies the assertion against the challenge from `/auth/passkey/options` and mints a session. The authenticator MUST have performed user verification (biometric / PIN) — a presence-only tap is refused on this path whatever the app policy says, because the passkey is the only authentication happening. Tokens carry `amr: ["webauthn"]` and a fresh `mfa_at`, so a passkey sign-in satisfies MFA-recency policies without a second step.

- Params: `Auth.PasskeyVerifyParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed: a required body field is missing, has the wrong type, or fails its format constraint. Produced by the global `ValidationPipe` before the handler runs; the response body lists the offending fields. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Invalid credentials. Returned identically for a forged assertion, an unknown credential, a challenge that was never issued, one already used, and one that has expired — the endpoint is not an account-existence oracle. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Signin is disabled for this app, or the account is suspended / deactivated. The status refusal is only reachable once the assertion has verified. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` in the path matches no app (or no live rename alias for one). This is about the **app**, not the account — it is decided before any identifier, code or credential in the body is looked at, so it is never a signal about whether an account or a contact exists. |
| 415 | `APIError` | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body was sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`). This API is JSON-only: a form body is a CORS-simple request that skips preflight, so accepting one would widen the CSRF surface. Send `application/json`. Rejected in `main.ts` before routing, on every non-GET request. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Per-IP burst limit on credential consumption. Per-IP rate limit (`RATE_LIMITED`): this path is in the `verify_code` bucket — 5 requests per minute per IP over a sliding 60-second window, shared across pods through Redis. Applied by `RateLimitMiddleware` before the handler runs, so it is reachable whatever the body says, and the response carries `Retry-After` in seconds. |

```ts
const consumerToken = await auth.consumer("my-app").passkey.verify({ credential: {} });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-auth-passkey-verify)

## consumer(…).permissions

### `auth.consumer(…).permissions.create(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/admin/permissions` → `Auth.ConsumerAdminPermission`

Create a custom permission.

Inserts a `<resource>.<action>` row in the per-app permission catalogue. The resource and action segments must each match `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,47}$`. Conflicts with a system permission name return 409. Customers usually then bind the new permission to a role via `PUT /admin/roles/:roleName/permissions`.

- Params: `Auth.ConsumerScopedPermissionCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Conflicts with a system permission or already exists in this app. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const consumerAdminPermission = await auth.consumer("my-app").permissions.create({ action: "read", resource: "project" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-admin-permissions)

### `auth.consumer(…).permissions.delete(permissionKey, options?)`

`DELETE /{app_slug}/v1/admin/permissions/{permission_key}` → `void`

Delete a custom permission.

The `permissionKey` path parameter is the literal `<resource>.<action>` string. System permissions cannot be deleted — attempts return 403. Removing a permission also removes every `role_permission` row that bound it (cascade); role lookups dropped of that perm on the next request.

- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | permissionKey must be in `resource.action` format. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Cannot delete system permissions. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Permission not found in this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await auth.consumer("my-app").permissions.delete("invoice.read");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#delete-app-slug-v1-admin-permissions-permission-key)

### `auth.consumer(…).permissions.list(options?)`

`GET /{app_slug}/v1/admin/permissions` → `Auth.ConsumerScopedPermissionListResponse`

List all permissions visible to this app.

Returns the union of system permissions (shared across every app — `is_system: true` in the response) and any custom entries this app has defined (`is_system: false`). Useful for driving a role-editor UI that picks from the full catalogue.

- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired Consumer-API bearer: an EndUser or M2M token, or an app API key (`hdk_live_*` / `hdk_test_*`); or the account, session, M2M client or key is no longer active, or the key belongs to another app. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app is suspended or archived (`APP_SUSPENDED` / `APP_ARCHIVED`), or the caller lacks `permission.read`: an app API key always needs it in its permissions; a role or M2M scopes need it once the app enforces permissions. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const result = await auth.consumer("my-app").permissions.list();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-app-slug-v1-admin-permissions)

### `auth.consumer(…).roles.retrieve(roleName, options?)`

`GET /{app_slug}/v1/admin/roles/{role_name}` → `Auth.ConsumerRoleWithPermissions`

Read one role with its permission set.

Returns the role plus the flat `permissions[]` array currently bound. Use this to drive a "configure role" UI in the customer product without having to call `/permissions` separately.

- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Role not found in this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const consumerRole = await auth.consumer("my-app").roles.retrieve("admin");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#get-app-slug-v1-admin-roles-role-name)

### `auth.consumer(…).roles.update(roleName, params?, options?)`

`PATCH /{app_slug}/v1/admin/roles/{role_name}` → `Auth.ConsumerRole`

Update a role's description.

Renames are intentionally NOT supported — the role name is part of every issued EndUser JWT, so changing it would silently break live sessions. Create a new role and migrate users instead.

- Params: `Auth.ConsumerScopedRoleUpdateParams`
- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Role not found in this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const consumerRole = await auth.consumer("my-app").roles.update("admin", { description: "Updated description" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#patch-app-slug-v1-admin-roles-role-name)

### `auth.consumer(…).roles.updatePermissions(roleName, params, options?)`

`PUT /{app_slug}/v1/admin/roles/{role_name}/permissions` → `Auth.ConsumerScopedRoleUpdatePermissionsResponse`

Replace a role's permission set.

Destructive — the role's permission set is replaced wholesale with the supplied array. Caller-narrowed: the caller must hold every permission in the request, otherwise 403 `Cannot grant actions you don't have: ...`. For EndUser callers the caller-held set is their app-membership role's effective permissions. For M2M callers the held set is the token's `scopes[]` claim — the M2M cannot grant a role any verb that wasn't configured on the M2M credential. Unknown permission strings return 400.

- Params: `Auth.ConsumerScopedRoleUpdatePermissionsParams`
- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Unknown permission(s) in the request. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | Caller is missing one or more permissions they're trying to grant. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Role not found in this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const result = await auth.consumer("my-app").roles.updatePermissions("admin", { permissions: ["user.read", "role.create"] });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#put-app-slug-v1-admin-roles-role-name-permissions)

## consumer(…).tenantApiKeys

### `auth.consumer(…).tenantApiKeys.create(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/tenant-api-keys` → `Auth.TenantApiKeyWithSecret`

Create an API key for the active tenant.

Returns the secret ONCE (`key`). Scopes must be grantable by the app and held by your own tenant role. At most 25 active keys per tenant. If the app requires recent MFA, verify a factor first (403 `step_up_required`). Responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store`.

- Params: `Auth.TenantApiKeyCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE`, `TENANT_API_KEY_EXPIRY_INVALID` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE` (`details.scopes`), `TENANT_API_KEY_EXPIRY_INVALID` (`details.allowed`), or a malformed `Idempotency-Key`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid end-user bearer token (M2M tokens, PAKs and API keys are refused). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_NOT_ENABLED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_APP_PROXY_ONLY`, `TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_FORBIDDEN`, `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_ABOVE_CEILING`, `step_up_required` | `TENANT_API_KEYS_NOT_ENABLED` (the app has not enabled tenant API keys), `TENANT_API_KEYS_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_APP_PROXY_ONLY` (the app manages keys through its own backend; call it instead), `TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` (no active tenant on the session: switch tenant first), `TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_FORBIDDEN` (your tenant role is not in the app's `manage_roles`), or a PAK refusal on `X-Heimdall-App-Key`. Also `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_ABOVE_CEILING` (`details.scopes`: scopes your role does not hold) and `step_up_required` (`details.max_age_minutes`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `TENANT_API_KEY_LIMIT`, `idempotency_secret_not_replayable`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `TENANT_API_KEY_LIMIT` (25 active keys), `idempotency_secret_not_replayable` (`details.key_id`), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const tenantApiKey = await auth.consumer("my-app").tenantApiKeys.create({ name: "CI e2e", scopes: ["disputes.read", "audit.read"] });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-tenant-api-keys)

### `auth.consumer(…).tenantApiKeys.delete(keyId, options?)`

`DELETE /{app_slug}/v1/tenant-api-keys/{key_id}` → `void`

Revoke an API key.

Immediate and final. Idempotent: revoking a revoked key is a 204 that changes nothing.

- Credential: [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid end-user bearer token (M2M tokens, PAKs and API keys are refused). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_NOT_ENABLED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_APP_PROXY_ONLY`, `TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_FORBIDDEN` | `TENANT_API_KEYS_NOT_ENABLED` (the app has not enabled tenant API keys), `TENANT_API_KEYS_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_APP_PROXY_ONLY` (the app manages keys through its own backend; call it instead), `TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` (no active tenant on the session: switch tenant first), `TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_FORBIDDEN` (your tenant role is not in the app's `manage_roles`), or a PAK refusal on `X-Heimdall-App-Key`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `TENANT_API_KEY_NOT_FOUND` | `TENANT_API_KEY_NOT_FOUND`: no such key in your active tenant (or app not found). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await auth.consumer("my-app").tenantApiKeys.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

### `auth.consumer(…).tenantApiKeys.introspect(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/tenant-api-keys/introspect` → `Auth.TenantApiKeyIntrospection`

Verify a tenant API key (RFC 7662 shape).

For your backend: is this `pctk_` key, presented to YOUR API, usable right now, for which tenant and with which scopes? A key of another app is `{"active": false}`. Cache answers by the key's SHA-256: positives up to 30 s (never past `expires_at`), negatives up to 60 s. Intersect `scopes` with the permissions of `created_by.tenant_role` in your app. Requires `auth.tenant.api_keys.introspect` on the app. Not audited per call; `last_used_at` records use (5-minute granularity). This route has its own per-app rate bucket (1200 calls a minute by default), separate from your PAK's other calls; over it the answer is 429 with `Retry-After`, never a false `active: false`, so keep serving keys you hold a fresh positive for.

- Params: `Auth.TenantApiKeyIntrospectParams`
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `key` missing or not a string. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, malformed or revoked Platform API Key (`Authorization: Bearer pcft_live_…`). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `PAK_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` | `PAK_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` (the PAK belongs to another workspace than the app), or the PAK's policy does not allow `auth.tenant.api_keys.introspect` on `pcft:heimdall:app/<appId>`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT` | The app has no workspace binding, so no PAK can act on it. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: this app's introspect bucket is exhausted for the current minute. `Retry-After` says when it refills. |

```ts
const tenantApiKeyIntrospection = await auth.consumer("my-app").tenantApiKeys.introspect({ key: "pctk_live_4fQ2aZ0000000000000000000000000000000000000_1a2B3c" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-tenant-api-keys-introspect)

`GET /{app_slug}/v1/tenant-api-keys` → `PagePromise<Auth.TenantApiKey>`

Newest first, cursor-paginated (20 per page, max 100). Secrets are never returned; `key_prefix` and `last4` identify a key.

| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

### `auth.consumer(…).tenantApiKeys.rotate(keyId, params?, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/tenant-api-keys/{key_id}/rotate` → `Auth.TenantApiKeyWithSecret`

Rotate an API key.

Mints a replacement with the same name and scopes and returns its secret ONCE. You become the replacement's creator, so its scopes must be within your own tenant role. The outgoing key is revoked now (`grace_hours: 0`, the default) or keeps working for up to 24 hours. To kill a leaked key, revoke it. Responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store`.

- Params: `Auth.TenantApiKeyRotateParams`

|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `TENANT_API_KEY_EXPIRY_INVALID` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` (`grace_hours` outside 0-24), `TENANT_API_KEY_EXPIRY_INVALID`, or a malformed `Idempotency-Key`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid end-user bearer token (M2M tokens, PAKs and API keys are refused). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_NOT_ENABLED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_APP_PROXY_ONLY`, `TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_FORBIDDEN`, `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_ABOVE_CEILING`, `step_up_required` | `TENANT_API_KEYS_NOT_ENABLED` (the app has not enabled tenant API keys), `TENANT_API_KEYS_SUSPENDED`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_APP_PROXY_ONLY` (the app manages keys through its own backend; call it instead), `TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` (no active tenant on the session: switch tenant first), `TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED`, `TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE`, `TENANT_API_KEYS_FORBIDDEN` (your tenant role is not in the app's `manage_roles`), or a PAK refusal on `X-Heimdall-App-Key`. Also `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_ABOVE_CEILING` and `step_up_required`. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `TENANT_API_KEY_NOT_FOUND` | `TENANT_API_KEY_NOT_FOUND`: no such key in your active tenant (or app not found). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `TENANT_API_KEY_NOT_ACTIVE`, `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE`, `idempotency_secret_not_replayable`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `TENANT_API_KEY_NOT_ACTIVE` (revoked or expired keys cannot be rotated), `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE` (the app no longer offers one of its scopes), `idempotency_secret_not_replayable`, or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const tenantApiKey = await auth.consumer("my-app").tenantApiKeys.rotate("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { expires_in_days: 7 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-tenant-api-keys-key-id-rotate)

## consumer(…).tenants.invites

### `auth.consumer(…).tenants.invites.create(tenantId, params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/invites` → `Auth.CreateTenantInvite`

Invite an email address into a tenant. Mints a pending invite, mails the code through the app's `invite_template_name` Envoi slot, and returns the plaintext code ONCE. PAK must hold auth.tenant.members.add.

Unlike `POST /members`, nothing is granted until the invitee accepts at `POST /:appSlug/v1/auth/accept-tenant-invite`. Only a SHA-256 digest of the code is stored, so the `code` in this response is unrecoverable afterwards.

- Params: `Auth.ConsumerScopedTenantInviteCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid email, unknown role, or maxUses/expiresInHours out of range. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | PAK missing. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | PAK policy denies action. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | Tenant not found. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | That email is already a member of the tenant, or already has a pending invite to it. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const createTenantInvite = await auth.consumer("my-app").tenants.invites.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { email: "alice@example.com", role_name: "member" });
```
