## consumer(…).users

### `auth.consumer(…).users.create(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/admin/users` → `Auth.ConsumerAdminCreatedUser`

Provision a new end-user.

Create an account in this app. Distinct from the public `/auth/signup`: no session is issued, no password is required (when omitted, the customer triggers a password-reset to finish onboarding), and the primary email contact starts unverified — the customer is responsible for kicking off the verification flow via `/auth/request-verification` or `/auth/send-verification-email`. The `roleName` defaults to the app's `signup_default_role`.

What is NOT distinct: the password policy. A supplied `password` goes through the same app-configured rules, the same common-password deny-list and the same breach check as `/auth/signup`.

- Params: `Auth.UserCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON`, `PASSWORD_BREACHED` | Invalid email, unknown role, or a password that fails the app policy — `PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON` / `PASSWORD_BREACHED`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired bearer token. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Email or username already in use. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 503 | `InternalServerError` | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service is momentarily busy (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`): too many password hashes or verifications are already running or queued on the instance that took the request. Nothing was changed and no attempt was counted. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (also in `details.retry_after_seconds`). Decided by instance load only, never by the identifier or the account, so it reveals nothing about whether an account exists. |

```ts
const consumerAdminCreatedUser = await auth.consumer("my-app").users.create({ email: "ada@example.com" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-admin-users)

### `auth.consumer(…).users.delete(userId, options?)`

`DELETE /{app_slug}/v1/admin/users/{user_id}` → `void`

Permanently delete an end-user.

Removes the account, its sessions, contacts, and tenant memberships. Audit rows are preserved, and the deletion itself is audited as `auth.account.deleted` with `via: consumer_admin` and the caller as actor. Fires `user.deleted` with `via: "consumer_admin"`.

- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired Consumer-API bearer: an EndUser or M2M token, or an app API key (`hdk_live_*` / `hdk_test_*`); or the account, session, M2M client or key is no longer active, or the key belongs to another app. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app is suspended or archived (`APP_SUSPENDED` / `APP_ARCHIVED`), or the caller lacks `user.delete`: an app API key always needs it in its permissions; a role or M2M scopes need it once the app enforces permissions. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await auth.consumer("my-app").users.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#delete-app-slug-v1-admin-users-user-id)

| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired Consumer-API bearer: an EndUser or M2M token, or an app API key (`hdk_live_*` / `hdk_test_*`); or the account, session, M2M client or key is no longer active, or the key belongs to another app. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app is suspended or archived (`APP_SUSPENDED` / `APP_ARCHIVED`), or the caller lacks `user.update`: an app API key always needs it in its permissions; a role or M2M scopes need it once the app enforces permissions. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app, or the end-user is not in this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const consumerAdminEndUser = await auth.consumer("my-app").users.update("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { display_name: "Ada Lovelace" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#patch-app-slug-v1-admin-users-user-id)

### `auth.consumer(…).users.updateRole(userId, params, options?)`

`PATCH /{app_slug}/v1/admin/users/{user_id}/role` → `Auth.ConsumerAdminRoleAssignment`

Assign an end-user a role.

Sets `app_membership.role_id` for the target user. For M2M callers the assignable role is bounded by the token's scopes (the guard already enforced `role.assign`); the role's own permission set is NOT additionally narrowed against the M2M scopes because M2M scopes are typically broader than per-user role perms by design (a backend cron with `user.list` + `role.assign` SHOULD be able to promote a user into a role carrying any per-app perm). EndUser admins are bounded by their own role's perms transitively — they couldn't authenticate as an admin without holding the perm.

- Params: `Auth.UserUpdateRoleParams`
- Credential: [`app_api_key`](#app_api_key) or [`m2m_token`](#m2m_token) or [`end_user_token`](#end_user_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed, or `role_name` names no role in this app. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, invalid or expired Consumer-API bearer: an EndUser or M2M token, or an app API key (`hdk_live_*` / `hdk_test_*`); or the account, session, M2M client or key is no longer active, or the key belongs to another app. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app is suspended or archived (`APP_SUSPENDED` / `APP_ARCHIVED`), or the caller lacks `role.assign`: an app API key always needs it in its permissions; a role or M2M scopes need it once the app enforces permissions. Also returned when an EndUser admin tries to assign a role carrying permissions they do not hold. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const consumerAdminRoleAssignment = await auth.consumer("my-app").users.updateRole("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { role_name: "member" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#patch-app-slug-v1-admin-users-user-id-role)

Setting status to `suspended` or `deactivated` also revokes all active sessions for the user (same behaviour as the auth-admin equivalent).

| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `APP_SUSPENDED`, `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app is suspended or archived (`APP_SUSPENDED` / `APP_ARCHIVED`), or the caller lacks `user.update`: an app API key always needs it in its permissions; a role or M2M scopes need it once the app enforces permissions. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app, or the end-user is not in this app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const consumerAdminEndUser = await auth.consumer("my-app").users.updateStatus("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { status: "active" });
```

## consumer(…).users.factors

### `auth.consumer(…).users.factors.create(userId, params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/users/{user_id}/factors` → `Auth.AdminProvisionFactor`

Provision an MFA factor on behalf of a user.

Creates the factor in the enabled state. TOTP: returns the cleartext secret + otpauth URI + recovery codes in the response — intended for synthetic-account-style flows where the caller bundles credentials and ships them out once. Email: binds the user's verified email contact (primary by default, `contact_id` to override; 412 when unverified) and returns the masked address + recovery codes — sign-in codes are then delivered on demand via `/auth/mfa/send-code`.

- Params: `Auth.UserFactorCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed (unsupported `type`, over-long `label`, non-UUID `contact_id`), or `type` is `webauthn` — passkeys cannot be provisioned out-of-band. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing bearer token, or the Platform API Key is malformed, unknown or revoked. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The PAK policy denies `auth.user.factors.provision` on this app's URN. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app (or the PAK belongs to another workspace), or the user is not in this app. Email factors: `contact_id` names no email contact on the account. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | The app has no workspace binding, so PAK access is refused until configured. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 412 | `APIError` | `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | Email factors: the contact (or primary email) is unverified, or the app has not completed Mail setup for MFA codes. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const adminProvisionFactor = await auth.consumer("my-app").users.factors.create("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { type: "totp" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-users-user-id-factors)

- Credential: [`workspace_key`](#workspace_key)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing bearer token, or the Platform API Key is malformed, unknown or revoked. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN` | The PAK policy denies `auth.user.factors.delete` on this app's URN. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app (or the PAK belongs to another workspace), or the user is not in this app. Also when the factor is not on that user. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT` | The app has no workspace binding, so PAK access is refused until configured. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await auth.consumer("my-app").users.factors.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

## consumer(…).verify

### `auth.consumer(…).verify.authorize(params?, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/authorize` → `Auth.Authorize`

Verify a token + check one or more permissions.

Returns `{ authorized: boolean }`. Pass `permission` (string) for a single check, or `permissions` (array) when ALL must be held.

Token source: `body.token` if provided, else the `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header. At least one must be present.

- Params: `Auth.VerifyAuthorizeParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed, neither `permission` nor `permissions` given, or no JWT supplied (body `token` or `Authorization: Bearer`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const authorize = await auth.consumer("my-app").verify.authorize({ permission: "invoice.read" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-authorize)

### `auth.consumer(…).verify.authorizeBatch(params, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/authorize/batch` → `Auth.AuthorizeBatch`

Multi-permission authorization in a single round-trip.

Runs N permission checks against the same token in one call. Each check accepts `permission` (singular) or `permissions` (array — ALL must be held); pass an `id` to correlate results back to inputs. Each result reports `authorized` plus the missing permissions (if any).

Token source: `body.token` if provided, else the `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header. At least one must be present.

- Params: `Auth.VerifyAuthorizeBatchParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed, a check has neither `permission` nor `permissions`, or no JWT supplied (body `token` or `Authorization: Bearer`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const authorizeBatch = await auth.consumer("my-app").verify.authorizeBatch({ checks: [{}] });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-authorize-batch)

### `auth.consumer(…).verify.token(params?, options?)`

`POST /{app_slug}/v1/verify` → `Auth.Verify`

Verify a token signature + return its principal.

Validates the JWT against the app's JWKS keys and returns `{ valid, principal }`. Use this when you need the full claims; use `/authorize` for a yes/no permission check.

Token source: `body.token` if provided, else the `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header. At least one must be present.

- Params: `Auth.VerifyTokenParams`
- Public: no API key, browser-safe

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Request validation failed (empty `token`), or no JWT supplied: neither `token` in the body nor an `Authorization: Bearer` header. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND` | The `:appSlug` matches no app. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limited: too many requests from this client IP in the last 60 seconds (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const verify = await auth.consumer("my-app").verify.token({ token: "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6ImsxIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c3JfMSJ9.c2lnbmF0dXJl" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/auth/api-reference#post-app-slug-v1-verify)

## Credentials

Routes take different credentials; each method above says which. Every one is sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. A workspace API key is the client's `apiKey` (or `PRODUCTCRAFT_API_KEY`); pass any other as `new Auth({ auth: { type: "bearer", token } })`. The wrong one answers 401.

### `app_api_key`

An app API key (`hdk_live_…` or `hdk_test_…`) minted for this app (`POST /v1/apps/{app_id}/api-keys`). Its permissions are always enforced. A workspace key is refused.

### `end_user_token`

An end user's access token for this app, from `signin`, `signup` or `refresh`. Acts as that user.

### `m2m_token`

An access token from this app's client-credentials grant (`POST /{app_slug}/v1/oauth/token`).

### `workspace_key`

A workspace API key (`pcft_live_…`, what the SDKs read from `PRODUCTCRAFT_API_KEY`) or a signed-in ProductCraft platform session token. Its workspace policy decides what it may do.

## Error codes

`err.code` on an `APIError` is one of these (an open set: new codes may appear).

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BAD_REQUEST` | The request is malformed (not valid JSON, a bad header, an unusable parameter). |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | One or more request fields are invalid; `errors` lists each field (`param`, `message`, `code`). |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | No credentials, or the token or API key is invalid, expired or revoked. |
| `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` | The workspace has no credit or plan for this operation. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | The caller is authenticated but not allowed to do this. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The resource does not exist, or belongs to another workspace or app. |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | The route does not accept this HTTP method. |
| `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` | The route cannot produce the requested content type. |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | The request took too long to arrive. |
| `CONFLICT` | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. |
| `GONE` | The resource existed but has been removed for good. |
| `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | A precondition header did not match. |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | The request body is over the size limit. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body is not in a content type the route accepts. |
| `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The request is well-formed but cannot be carried out. |
| `PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` | The route requires a precondition header. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests; retry after the `Retry-After` header. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | An unexpected server error. Retrying is safe for idempotent requests; quote `request_id` to support. |
| `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | The server does not support this operation. |
| `BAD_GATEWAY` | An upstream service returned an invalid response. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service or one of its dependencies is temporarily unavailable; retry. |
| `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT` | An upstream service did not answer in time; retry. |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The workspace has not enabled this product. |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | The credentials were not accepted. |
| `SESSION_REVOKED` | The session behind this token was signed out or revoked. |
| `MCP_NOT_PERMITTED` | An MCP (agent) token cannot call this route. |
| `MCP_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` | The MCP token was issued for a different workspace. |
| `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | A workspace API key cannot call this route. |
| `ACTIONS_NOT_GRANTABLE` | The policy grants actions the caller does not hold. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | This operation requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds with the same key to get its response. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT` | The workspace has the maximum number of webhook endpoints. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook endpoint with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED` | The endpoint is not subscribed to this event type. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook event with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | The event type is not one this product sends. |
| `ACCOUNT_EXISTS` | An account already exists for this address. Sign in and accept the invite from your account instead. |
| `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND` | Account not found. |
| `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED` | Account suspended. |
| `APEX_NOT_SUPPORTED` | A custom domain must be a subdomain, not the apex of a zone. |
| `APP_ARCHIVED` | The app is archived. |
| `APP_HAS_NO_WORKSPACE` | App has no workspace. |
| `APP_NOT_FOUND` | App not found. |
| `APP_SUSPENDED` | The app is suspended; its consumer routes are closed. |
| `AUTH_SETTINGS_IN_METADATA` | Sign-in settings cannot be changed through app metadata. Use PATCH /v1/apps/{appId}/auth-config, or leave the auth key out of metadata. |
| `AVATAR_INVALID_TYPE` | Avatar file could not be decoded as an image. |
| `AVATAR_MAGIC_MISMATCH` | Avatar file content does not match declared type. |
| `AVATAR_NOT_FOUND` | Avatar not found. |
| `AVATAR_TOO_LARGE` | Avatar exceeds 2 MB. |
| `BOT_PROTECTION_FAILED` | The bot-protection token was rejected. |
| `BOT_PROTECTION_REQUIRED` | The app requires a bot-protection token on sign-up. |
| `BOT_PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE` | Bot protection could not be checked; retry. |
| `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_EXISTS` | This app already has a custom domain; remove it before adding another. |
| `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_ACTIVE` | This app has no active custom domain to test on. Finish its setup first. |
| `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_NOT_FOUND` | Custom domain not found. |
| `CUSTOM_DOMAIN_OAUTH_ONLY` | The custom domain only serves OAuth routes; test sign-in on the app domain instead. |
| `DNS_CONFLICTS` | Some records cannot be written without breaking existing ones; nothing was changed. |
| `ENVOI_APP_NOT_BOUND_TO_WORKSPACE` | The app is not linked to a workspace, so it cannot send through Mail. |
| `ENVOI_NOT_ENABLED` | Mail is not enabled for the app's workspace. |
| `ENVOI_NOT_WIRED` | Mail client not wired in this deployment. |
| `ENVOI_SENDER_NOT_CONFIGURED` | No sender address is set for this notification. |
| `ENVOI_TEMPLATE_NOT_CONFIGURED` | No Mail template is set for this notification. |
| `FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED` | Custom domains are not available for this workspace yet. |
| `HOSTNAME_RESERVED` | That host name is reserved and cannot be used. |
| `HOSTNAME_TAKEN` | That host name is already used by another app. |
| `INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS` | The token does not grant the permission this route needs. |
| `INVALID_FORMAT` | A path or query value is not in the expected format. |
| `INVALID_HOSTNAME` | The host name is not valid; use a name such as `auth.example.com`. |
| `INVALID_IDENTIFIER` | An id in the path or query is not a valid UUID. |
| `INVALID_PROVIDER` | Unsupported DNS provider. |
| `INVALID_ZONE` | The DNS zone is not one this domain belongs to. |
| `MAIL_UNREACHABLE` | The Mail service did not answer; try again in a minute. |
| `PAK_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` | The workspace API key belongs to a different workspace. |
| `PASSWORD_BREACHED` | This password has appeared in a known data breach — pick a different one. |
| `PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON` | Password is too common — pick something less guessable. |
| `PROVIDER_ERROR` | The DNS provider returned an error. |
| `PROVIDER_PERMISSION_DENIED` | The DNS provider token lacks permission to edit this zone. |
| `PROVIDER_TOKEN_REJECTED` | The DNS provider rejected the token. |
| `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | The DNS provider is unavailable; try again later. |
| `PROVIDER_ZONE_NOT_FOUND` | The DNS provider has no zone for this domain. |
| `ROLE_IN_USE` | Role is in use. |
| `SENDER_ADDRESS_REQUIRED` | A sender address is required for these notification settings. |
| `SESSION_EXPIRED` | Session expired. |
| `SIGN_IN_TEST_INVALID` | This sign-in test link is unknown, already used or expired. Start a new test from the console. |
| `SLUG_TAKEN` | The clone needs a slug of its own. |
| `SLUG_UUID_SHAPED` | A slug cannot look like a UUID. |
| `TENANT_API_KEYS_APP_PROXY_ONLY` | Tenant API keys for this app are managed through the app, not directly. |
| `TENANT_API_KEYS_FORBIDDEN` | Your tenant role cannot manage API keys. |
| `TENANT_API_KEYS_NOT_ENABLED` | Tenant API keys are not enabled for this app. |
| `TENANT_API_KEYS_NO_SCOPES` | Enabling tenant API keys needs at least one grantable scope. |
| `TENANT_API_KEYS_SCOPE_INVALID` | A scope name is malformed; scopes look like `orders.read` (`details.scopes`). |
| `TENANT_API_KEYS_SUSPENDED` | Tenant API keys are suspended for this app. |
| `TENANT_API_KEYS_SUSPENDED_NOT_WRITABLE` | Tenant API keys are suspended for this app; only `suspended` can be changed. |
| `TENANT_API_KEYS_UNKNOWN_ROLE` | `manage_roles` names a role this app does not have (`details.roles`). |
| `TENANT_API_KEY_EXPIRY_INVALID` | The requested expiry is not one of the allowed values (`details.allowed`). |
| `TENANT_API_KEY_LIMIT` | The tenant has the maximum number of active API keys (25); revoke one first. |
| `TENANT_API_KEY_NOT_ACTIVE` | Only an active key can be rotated. |
| `TENANT_API_KEY_NOT_FOUND` | API key not found. |
| `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_ABOVE_CEILING` | You cannot rotate a key whose scopes your own tenant role does not hold. |
| `TENANT_API_KEY_SCOPE_NOT_GRANTABLE` | Some scopes are not offered by this app. |
| `TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` | No active tenant on this session. Switch to a tenant first (POST /auth/switch-tenant). |
| `TENANT_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED` | You are not a member of the active tenant. |
| `TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE` | The active tenant is not active. |
| `TOKEN_EXPIRED` | Token expired. |
| `TOKEN_INVALID` | Token invalid. |
| `TOKEN_REVOKED` | Token revoked. |
| `USERNAME_TAKEN` | Username already in use. |
| `account_exists_with_different_provider` | An account with this email exists and signs in with a different method. |
| `idempotency_secret_not_replayable` | A repeat of a key-creating request: the secret is never replayed (`details.key_id`). |
| `link_required` | An account with this email exists; confirm the link to sign in with this provider. |
| `step_up_required` | Recent MFA is required; verify a factor and retry (`details.max_age_minutes`). |
